name: craft
description: Audit decisions, specify behavior, build minimally, detect drift, and feed defects back into the spec.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, specify, build, detect drift, and learn
interface.longDescription: A personal spec-driven workflow combining decision audits, minimal implementation, compact specifications, read-only drift detection, and defect backpropagation.
defaultPrompt: Use $craft:spec to turn this idea into SPEC.md.
Use $craft:build --next to complete the next task.
Use $craft:check to reconcile SPEC.md with current code.
